components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Cairo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; background: #0A3568; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(10, 53, 104, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A3568; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; background: #F97316; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.88); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis actions such as View products.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0F172A; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #F1F5F9; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Active cross-filter badge with clear control.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; background: #F1F5F9; color: #0F172A; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-x { border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px; border-radius: 999px; line-height: 1; } .ds-chip-x:hover { background: #E2E8F0; }

narrative.overview: Staff review refugee and humanitarian program data in a bright office during working hours. The interface should feel like a trusted internal briefing pack: calm surfaces, one strong navy anchor, orange only where attention is earned.
keyCharacteristics: Bilingual Noto Sans Arabic / Cairo / Inter stack
Clickable full chart columns and legend rows for cross-filter

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange and navy each have a job: navy carries structure; orange carries attention.

rules.name: The Truncate-and-Tooltip Rule
rules.body: Long Arabic category names truncate on chart axes; full strings always appear in tooltips and clickable legend rows.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Do not use backdrop blur or glassmorphism for dashboards.

dos: Do pick chart types by data shape.
Do make entire chart columns and legend rows filter targets.
Do use CSS variable series colors for Recharts fills.
Do show sync freshness near warehouse-backed analytics.
donts: Don't use hero-metric cards with gradient numbers and decorative icon grids.
Don't use pie charts for nationality or product categories.
Don't use generic dark-blue neon ops styling or glassmorphism cards.
Don't use side-stripe colored borders on alerts or KPI callouts.
Don't paste Power BI chrome into surfaces that already have a custom warehouse dashboard.
